Ibrahim CSM: Scheduling note — MapleTech EBR Thurs 9:30am PT. Need a one-slide playbook (visual flow + 3 bullets) and a live action feed for post-EBR ops. Draft slides at ~v0.3 in the drive.
Zoe SE: I can take demo choreography. Plan: 1 canonical flow + 1 micro-fallback for cold-KV. Keep demos <=3:30 each.
Harper AM: We need a 30s renewal signal for the exec slide. Health fell ~9% after onboarding lag + two escalated invoices. Can someone pull tagged tickets (#onboard, #billing)?
Maya Enablement: Ill own the action feed and capture enablement asks. Proposing a 20-min run-through Wed morning to validate owners.
notebot: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/mapletech/ebr_v0.3  comments on slide 1 and notes.
Ibrahim CSM: Zoe, add slide note: `Fallback: use quantized model if p95 > 280ms` (single line). Also include a 1-line demo contingency: "switch to recorded GIF if streaming fails."
Zoe SE: ack. I'll add step bullets and a tiny offline GIF in case of network issues.
Harper AM: Risk snapshot (short): (1) onboarding backlog, (2) SLA gap on batch ingest, (3) billing dispute. I'll draft a 2-line exec blurb with mitigations and confidence level.
Maya Enablement: Action feed template: `Owner | Task | Due | Priority | Status | Follow-up`. I'll make it editable to owners and view-only for execs. Adding a "confidence" tag per row.
Ibrahim CSM: Deadlines: slides updated by Wed 8am, run-through Wed 11am, sheet link in deck, exec intro 45s health + 90s roadmap. Call out conflicts now.
Harper AM: I have a calendar conflict Wed morning  will record a 90s voice blurb for my exec line and upload.
Zoe SE: Engineering ask: can eng-runtime paste 1 bullets explaining recent perf variance for slide notes? Will invite @eng-runtime to the run-through.
Maya Enablement: Live feed link: https://sheets.redwood.com/mapletech-ebr-feed  populating rows and pinging owners now.
Ibrahim CSM: Great progress. After run-through we'll triage actions by priority and assign SLAs. Please confirm owners by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
